name: funderDOI
description: DOI (Digital Object Identifier) for a funding organization, providing a persistent, resolvable identifier for the funder.
ExpectedUse: Persistent identification of funding organizations using DOI identifiers in grant and funding metadata contexts. Commonly used with CrossRef Funder Registry DOIs (e.g., 10.13039/501100001659 for DFG), but applicable to any DOI-based funder identifier system.
